exposure: fetal growth below the second standard deviation
cohort: 2312 preterm breech deliveries (24 + 0 to 36 + 6 gestational weeks) in Finland from 2004 to 2018
finding: Several risk factors were identified for adverse neonatal outcomes in planned vaginal breech delivery, including maternal obesity, smoking, congenital anomalies, preterm premature rupture of membranes, oligohydramnios, epidural anesthesia, and fetal growth below the second standard deviation.
mod_finding: The study investigated risk factors for adverse outcomes in attempted vaginal preterm breech deliveries compared to those born via emergency cesarean section.
